name: Rhys Ceridwen
source:
Job: Witch Councilman
Skill: Eyes of the Oracle
Hobby: Classic literature, historical literature, arcane studies
Loves: Opera, ballet, symphonies, fine arts, museums
Pet Peeve: Not being taken seriously because of his gender

“Every time I think I have you figured out, you surprise me.”
 
As the eldest son in his family and the first male member of the Witch Council, Rhys has grown a strong sense of responsibility. Despite his quiet demeanor, he is a man of deep passions and intense focus.

[From the game's [url=http://kissesandcurses.voltage-ent.com/index.php/characters/]website[/url]]
